motivation: E2B copies the JSON escape of the harness's file view into its edits: 78 of 364 failed edits in five unedited official runs carry backslash-quote in old_string and 26 of 220 applied edits write one into the code. A neuron that fires inside tool-call strings and favours each unescaped token over its escaped twin targets that step without training.
hypothesis: The de-escaping neuron raises the share of applying bench answers on held-out states against the unedited model (exact McNemar p < 0.05) and against a control neuron, with no fewer correct answers and no significant MBPP+ loss.

config.control: random write orthogonal to u, same norm, same read-out
